title: runtime/pack
description: PolicyPack contract (feature 004; FR-302/FR-305/FR-308): validated-data policy. templates are declarative single-writer actions; decision_map binds typed systemone answers to templates; emergency rules are deterministic no-model reflexes. Immutable during scored runs; the revision hash rides in every action.* event.

pack_id.description: id grammar (common/id) with the pack. prefix.

revision.description: Human-readable revision tag; the canonical-JSON hash is authoritative (feature 001).

policy_version.description: Policy primitive vocabulary version (feature 012; UR-BRN-014): the runtime interpreter validates @fn/selector/op names against this version. Absent = pre-engine pack (no phases/rules).

class.description: Pack class (UR-BRN-018): 'fair' packs declare zero dev.* bridge methods and are loadable under --fair; 'dev' packs carry test/debug tooling (spawn/heal/checkpoint scripts) and are refused at load in fair runs. Absent = unclassified.

method.description: Bridge RPC method; must exist in the sealed inventory or the pack is rejected at load.

params_schema.description: JSON-Schema subset (draft 2020-12) applied to dispatch params before any write.

require.description: Params that must be present (in addition to params_schema).

jobs.description: Survival job ids this pack covers (food, emergency, ...).

fallback_plan.description: Deterministic rules-only plan the planner loop emits when the planning tier degrades to the terminal sentinel (feature 005, FR-408). Pack-authored data so degraded behavior is visible in pack diffs.

question.description: Systemone question id the answer came from.

choice.description: Selected choice id; score/noul thresholds below may also trigger.

score.description: Optional trigger: answer score >= this value maps too.

noul.description: Optional trigger: answer noul >= this value maps too.

action.description: Dispatcher action the answer maps to; unmapped answers are refused (FR-303).

priority.description: Lower fires first when several rules match.

value.description: Any JSON value; type compatibility checked at eval.

action.description: Reflex action dispatched without any model call (FR-308).

start.description: Start-mode config (feature 008): site ranking weights, shelter dims, recreation defs, food policy, exit conditions. Absent on non-start packs.

govern.description: Standing post-start goals (UR-RUN-009): ordered {id, when?, requires?, need?, effect, steps, repeat?} evaluated every poll after the start exit contract holds on a held run. Terminal goals re-arm while their effect lapses — sustainment and long-horizon objectives (research queue, mission letters) share the phase machinery.

goal_options.description: Overarching strategic goal options (catalog-level, not committed policy): [{id, summary, survival_benefit, investment, wealth_impact, raid_threat_impact, phase, prerequisites, sources}] the planner weighs against the raid-points economy and may promote into govern.goals or a plan.

improve.description: Self-improvement cycle config (feature 009): defect patterns, metric weights, audit gate list, cadence. Absent on non-improvement packs.

combat.description: Combat-test config (feature 010): checkpoint name, incident def, bounded points/rounds/tick budget. Test mode only, never scored.

cycle.description: Save-reset cycle config (feature 010): checkpoint name, phase ordering, per-phase budgets.

universal.description: Universal pawn rules (feature 011): idle-job fallbacks, combat target discipline, post-combat strip. Applies in every mode.

mutate.description: Live-mutation trigger policy (feature 016; FR-1402/1412): goals_per_pass cadence, on_failure / near_failure thresholds, cooldown_polls, max_passes_per_run, max_ops. Absent = no in-run reflection passes even under --live-mutate.

params.description: Template params; validated against the template's params_schema at dispatch.
